macros.name: Disable
macros.doc: \Disable {⟨tokens⟩} provides a way to ignore additional commands when using \includeenv and friends.

macros.name: IfAllowed
macros.doc: \IfAllowed {⟨part name⟩}{⟨true⟩}{⟨false⟩} executes ⟨true⟩ if ⟨part-name⟩ is on the list of files to be included and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: includeall
macros.doc: The \includeall command cancels the effect of any \includeonly command presently in effect.

macros.name: IncludeName
macros.doc: \IncludeName expands to the name of the part currently being processed.

macros.name: IncludeSurround
macros.doc: The contents of \IncludeSurround are inserted before the ⟨prehook⟩ or whatever has been specified with \AtBeginInclude, and after the ⟨posthook⟩ or whatever has been specified with \AtEndInclude.

macros.name: ParentName
macros.doc: \ParentName expands to the name of the part that includes the part currently being processed.
